description: This file defines the ZoneService interface, which extends a generic SalesManagerEntityService to provide operations related to managing Zone entities, including retrieving zones by code, adding descriptions, and fetching zones based on country and language.

classes.name: ZoneService
classes.description: Interface for zone-related operations, extending the generic sales manager entity service.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieve a Zone entity based on its unique code.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Add a description to a given Zone, may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: getZones
methods.description: Retrieve list of zones for a specific country and language.

methods.name: getZones
methods.description: Retrieve a map of zones keyed by code for a specific language.
